title: DR1 lets the user search the transporter directory by name, address or approval number; the frontend's page is headed "Search for an approved commercial transporter" but has no search box.

finding.frontend: The page is titled and headed "Search for an approved commercial transporter" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/copy/copy.en.js:89-91) but the whole form is a single radio group and nothing else: the rendered page offers two radio options and the Save buttons, with no text input of any kind (transporters-select/transporters-select.njk:11-23). A user who reads the heading and looks for somewhere to type has nowhere to type. Because the list is a fixed pair of records (src/server/app/services/commercial-transporters/records.js:6-27) scrolling is currently short, but the page has no way to narrow a longer list.
finding.prototype: The transporter list sits under a "Select a transporter" heading with a labelled search field above it — label "Search", hint "Name, address or approval number", a text input and a search button (app/views/transporter.html:75-95). Typing filters the rows in place.
finding.difference: Add a search field above the transporter list, labelled "Search" with the hint "Name, address or approval number", filtering the list on those three values. Nothing blocks it: the filter can run over the records the page already holds. It travels with the finding about the list's missing columns, since both change the same list.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a text input inside the form on fe-transporter-commercial in the captured DOM — capture/html/frontend/fe-transporter-commercial.html contains only radio inputs and the hidden crumb field.

relatedTo.why: both rebuild the same transporter list
